description: mapy.opolskie.pl: road datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Geoportal Opole Province, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by mapy.opolskie.pl. Coverage: the area served by mapy.opolskie.pl. The listing groups 23 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about road; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Zmiana Miejscowego Planu Zagospodarowania Przestrzennego w rejonie obw; Zmiana miejscowego planu ogólnego zagospodarowania przestrzennego gmin; Zmiana miejscowego planu zagospodarowania w rejonie ulicy Prudnickiej ; Zmiana miejscowego planu zagospodarowania przestrzennego części gruntó. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-opole.
